It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} The district consists of the provincial capital city [[Palayan]], its largest city [[Cabanatuan]], and adjacent municipalities, namely [[Bongabon]], [[Gabaldon, Nueva Ecija|Gabaldon]], [[General Mamerto Natividad]], [[Laur, Nueva Ecija|Laur]] and [[Santa Rosa, Nueva Ecija|Santa Rosa]] bordering [[Aurora (province)|Aurora]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Jay Vergara]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
